title: Input consistency acceptance probability
statement: Let $n>0$, let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, let $w$ be an input word, and let $p$ be a Boolean proof word of the circuit’s prescribed length. The input consistency tester’s acceptance probability on $(w,p)$ equals the average over input coordinates $i$ of the probability, for uniformly chosen $y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, that the local correction of the sign-valued function encoded by the linear portion of the inner proof agrees with the sign encoding of $w_i$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean proof word of the prescribed length
